method.name: default
method.description: Creates a point with zero coordinates.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a point from a XYZ object.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a point with its 3 cartesian's coordinates : theXp, theYp, theZp.

method.name: SetCoord_1
method.description: Changes the coordinate of range theIndex : theIndex = 1 => X is modified theIndex = 2 => Y is modified theIndex = 3 => Z is modified Raised if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}.

method.name: SetCoord_2
method.description: For this point, assigns the values theXp, theYp and theZp to its three coordinates.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this point.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Y coordinate of this point.

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Z coordinate of this point.

method.name: SetXYZ
method.description: Assigns the three coordinates of theCoord to this point.

method.name: Coord_2
method.description: Returns the coordinate of corresponding to the value of theIndex : theIndex = 1 => X is returned theIndex = 2 => Y is returned theIndex = 3 => Z is returned Raises OutOfRange if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}. Raised if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}.

method.name: Coord_3
method.description: For this point gives its three coordinates theXp, theYp and theZp.

method.name: X
method.description: For this point, returns its X coordinate.

method.name: Y
method.description: For this point, returns its Y coordinate.

method.name: Z
method.description: For this point, returns its Z coordinate.

method.name: XYZ
method.description: For this point, returns its three coordinates as a XYZ object.

method.name: Coord_1
method.description: For this point, returns its three coordinates as a XYZ object.

method.name: ChangeCoord
method.description: Returns the coordinates of this point. Note: This syntax allows direct modification of the returned value.

method.name: BaryCenter
method.description: Assigns the result of the following expression to this point (theAlpha*this + theBeta*theP) / (theAlpha + theBeta)

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the distance between two points.

method.name: SquareDistance
method.description: Computes the square distance between two points.

method.name: Mirror_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a point with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a point with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a point with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Rotates a point. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scale
method.description: Scales a point. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Transforms a point with the transformation T.

method.name: Translate_1
method.description: Translates a point in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translate_2
method.description: Translates a point from the point theP1 to the point theP2.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
